title: Airflow OpenLineage commissioning, source review and independent customer handover

task.name: Commission and independently receive the agreed native Airflow DAG cohort
task.purpose: Give the customer a usable operating path from its real Airflow environment and selected DAGs through original OpenLineage events, saved baseline and following editions, task coverage review and a complete editable handover connected to the same commercial Installation.
task.request: Agree the complete DAG and logical-date cohort, original source authority, business purpose, provider policy and receiving scope. Read the actual Airflow and Python environment and retain its observation. Use the maintained Airflow plan and original OpenLineage provider configuration; select the real workspace, namespace, provider version and host-owned credential references. Preserve every expected terminal state, task declaration, actual execution identity and logical date. Begin the original session before running the customer's selected native DAG command through the original controller. Retain original process output, actual native state and complete provider event bodies. Capture and save the complete first native edition, make the agreed source or operating correction and save a distinct following edition. Read the full event/source populations, native task states, task emission declarations, unexpected events and source differences. Export the complete source-bearing Airflow handover through the original application. Attach its exact bytes to the original Operations case, explicitly include or exclude every saved DAG/run/date row with its role and purpose, and preserve the original commercial Workshare, funded assignments and open acceptance checks. Prepare the existing Installation through its native preview and save. Independently receive the whole Airflow workspace, installed source/runtime selection and full Operations case on the named private receiving host. Rebind host-local credentials, operate the actual desktop and narrow screens, view their actual images, reopen downloads and cold reopen the retained workspace. Record acceptance against the original customer checks and actual observations.
task.completeOutput: The complete agreed native DAG cohort, real environment/plan/session identities, original provider event bodies and task coverage, two distinct saved native editions, explicit whole-cohort selection, complete executable source and workspace handover, retained runtime selection, independent receive/reopen result and original commercial Installation.
task.repeatTrigger: A real changed DAG/source, provider policy, operating cohort, source schema or business purpose creates useful following work. Replaying an uncertain original request, restarting its service or downloading another format continues that original operation.
task.pricedUnit: One agreed whole DAG-cohort commissioning and independent receiving task. Select the actual merchant-priced unit and atomic task budget in the original case. Engineering fees, effort, schedule, customer support and changes remain in the original Workshare.

source.reference: Exact complete original Airflow handover and embedded workspace package; original plan hashes, saved review/edition identities and full explicitly selected DAG/run/date cohort; original commercial Workshare and approved customer source scope.
source.mode: The maintained Apache Airflow OpenLineage provider and original commissioning application. Preserve the actual environment observation, selected provider 2.20.2 contract and native DAG execution. Host-owned environment references supply credentials.
source.population: Every original operator source, embedded application file, commissioning plan/session/review/comparison, retained object and complete event body in the handover. Preserve all saved DAG/run/date rows, task coverage, task runs, expected and actual terminal states, original native execution where retained, and explicit inclusion or exclusion purposes.
source.meaning: Keep the Airflow run ID, OpenLineage run IDs, timezone-qualified logical date, DAG identity, namespace, original plan hash and saved edition distinct. An expected FAIL or ABORT can be a valid planned native observation. Preserve skipped/upstream-failed or nonemitting tasks under their original provider declarations. A complete saved native review records the native outcome; customer acceptance remains the attributed original Installation check.
source.changePolicy: Receive changed source and plans as original subsequent editions while retaining all previous source and observations. Review every change in DAG/run/date/edition identity, keep all cohort rows, and explicitly assign baseline/corrected/following/other roles. Preserve the same original operation and request identity after uncertain output. Edit an already operated Installation through its original current draft.

receiving.application: The existing OpenLineage workspace, maintained Airflow commissioning operator and Grant Operations Installation desk composed by the airflow-installation source selection. Receive the complete existing private workspace or initialize the original workspace before starting its Applications provider.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Bind the exact full handover and full cohort selection to their original case source IDs and byte hashes. The source report requires distinct complete saved native editions and preserves every native observation. Prepare from the current original commercial Workshare seed; retain funded assignments, phases, checks, payment choices and coordination. Independently receive the complete applications and full populated case, operate actual screens and reopen source/downloads. Record each actual acceptance decision through the original Installation.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The customer platform owner retains DAG, environment and rollout authority. The engineer changes selections and source through the maintained original application and reviews changed native results. Host-owned environment configuration retains actual credentials. Commercial scope, funding, acceptance and withdrawal remain in the original Workshare and Installation history.
receiving.recovery: Retain original request ID, complete command body, source byte hash, workspace identity and receiver directory. Read the actual original operation or receiving marker before resuming. Reusing the same handover preserves subsequent recipient changes through the original receiver. Lost case responses replay the original Operations request; whole-case receiving retains original version and source references. Resume the existing native commissioning controller and original results instead of creating another simulation or replacing observations.
receiving.maintenance: Name the customer source/platform owner, implementation engineer, commercial prime and independent receiving engineer. Deliver complete editable application source, source/runtime manifests, original guides, cohort and handover, host environment-variable names, recovery path and agreed support. Preserve actual customer source and credentials in their authorized private destinations; keep grant costs and commercial revenue in their original assignments.

steps.title: Select the whole customer and commercial scope
steps.result: Receive the complete original Workshare seed and current pinned Operations plan. Select the agreed DAGs, source authority, purpose, environments, acceptance phases, effort and accountable receiving owner.

steps.title: Receive both maintained applications
steps.result: Install the complete airflow-installation source/runtime selection, original OpenLineage workspace and Airflow operator, and existing Grant Operations workspace. Read its full manifest and initialize or receive the original private directories.

steps.title: Observe the real native environment
steps.result: Read actual Airflow/Python/provider versions and native environment configuration. Preserve the full original observation, namespace, source references, selected provider policy and host-owned credential names.

steps.title: Run and save the original native editions
steps.result: Begin the original commissioning session, execute the exact selected native DAG command and preserve original process output and complete provider events. Capture the first complete edition, apply the agreed correction, and capture a distinct following native edition.

steps.title: Read the complete cohort and source
steps.result: Review every original DAG/run/date, planned terminal state, actual native state, task coverage and task run; inspect source and original event bodies. Retain exclusions and unresolved choices with their actual business reason.

steps.title: Bind the whole handover to Installation
steps.result: Export and attach the complete original Airflow handover. Generate fresh whole-cohort and customer-binding templates from the current Workshare seed. Select every row explicitly, attach the complete selection and prepare the original native Installation preview and full workorder.

steps.title: Record actual customer outcomes
steps.result: Use the original preview and save sequence. Retain original commercial checks and funded phases. Record observed work, purchases, support, acceptance and changes against the correct source and original Installation.

steps.title: Receive and operate independently
steps.result: Receive the complete Airflow handover into a new private directory using its maintained receiver; receive the full Operations case through its original importer. Rebind environment references, compare original source identities and cold reopen both applications.

steps.title: Inspect the complete outgoing experience
steps.result: Open and operate the exact desktop and narrow products, look at their rendered images, use cohort/source/member controls, download full original bytes, reopen the actual exports and retain the independent receiving result.

inputs: Current complete original Workshare seed, pinned Operations plan, current case version and whole original commercial/funding/acceptance records.
Actual authorized Airflow DAG source, complete environment observation, original provider policy/configuration and native operation/session/plan identities.
Complete original source-bearing Airflow handover, at least two distinct saved native editions and exact raw-byte/workspace package hashes.
All original saved review rows with explicit baseline/corrected/following/other role and inclusion or exclusion purpose; actual original execution results where retained.
Original case handover and selected-cohort source IDs/hashes; same current merchant/customer deployments, payment bindings, source-use authority and receiving owner.
Whole installed application/runtime manifest and maintained source selection; independent private Airflow receiving directory and original Operations case workspace.
Actual original task/event observations, acceptance decisions, desktop/narrow images viewed, complete downloads and cold-reopen results.
